81148.subject: 💰 OpenAI races to beat Anthropic IPO
81148.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $81,404 (-1.1%) | **ETH** $2,382 (-1.5%) | **SOL** $104 (-0.7%)

* J.P. Morgan Asset Management adds Bitcoin to long-term forecasts, projects [10% annual return](https://www.chooserich.live/story/jpmorgan-asset-management-bitcoin-forecasts-3yjsaa5)

* OpenAI races to raise $30B at a [$1.4T valuation](https://www.chooserich.live/story/openai-accelerates-funding-round-suej8nt) ahead of Anthropic's IPO

* SkyAI sells its entire Solana treasury and launches a [$201M buyback](https://www.chooserich.live/story/skyai-sells-solana-treasury-tender-offer-5kkwwhp) at $3 per token

* US spot bitcoin ETFs post [$526.6M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/blackrock-ibit-bitcoin-etf-inflows-4i9qtdi) in net inflows

* BlackRock files for iShares [Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF](https://www.chooserich.live/story/blackrock-files-bitcoin-etf-pbit-3c349wy)

* Sparkasse lets its [40 million](https://www.chooserich.live/story/sparkassen-launches-crypto-trading-4k348up) German customers buy Bitcoin

* Tenstorrent raises $1.5B Series E, valuing the AI chip startup at [$6.2B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/tenstorrent-raises-funding-series-e-5kgxtar)

* Nine companies including Verizon and Broadcom [reject tokenized shares](https://www.chooserich.live/story/firms-oppose-okxice-tokenized-shares-8pckdpt)

* Binance launches [AI Pro](https://www.chooserich.live/story/binance-launches-ai-pro-trading-widgnm3), an agent that builds and paper-tests trading strategies from plain language — BNB Chain completes its 37th quarterly Auto-Burn, removing about [1.65M BNB](https://www.chooserich.live/story/bnb-chain-quarterly-token-burn-8dxaw5q)

* Strategy buys 267 Bitcoin for [$22M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/strategy-buys-bitcoin-7p3tkgs) — Strive buys [1,223 Bitcoin](https://www.chooserich.live/story/strive-buys-bitcoin-ah4sikx)

* S&P 500 put options hit a record [$3.37T](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2112075023598993542) single-day notional volume on Friday

* A single Chinese-speaking hacker uses AI agents to breach [100+ entities](https://www.chooserich.live/story/hacker-uses-ai-agents-breaches-y92j389)

* TRON settles about [73%](https://www.chooserich.live/story/stablecoin-payments-volume-record-pf2tikr) of all stablecoin volume in Q3, leading every chain

* Papertrade decides to keep their PAPER token non-transferrable and change tokenomics to allow for [uncapped inflation](https://x.com/papertrade_xyz/status/2112310325521399982?s=20)

Daily Crypto Digest

Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/daily-crypto-digest-october-20-oleh-bezuhlyi-kuasf?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BKQQ2dKuPQcKa48UiiQmCMQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=16RXP7nHQvSYs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mvgnbrsi~yd-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mvgnbrsi-yd
  
🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin slipped back toward $81K as equity weakness and oil weighed on risk, yet BlackRock's IBIT logged its strongest day in a year. Regulators and payment giants kept building the rails beneath the chop. 🏦 BlackRock Files for "Buffer" Bitcoin ETF as IBIT Pulls $665M in a Day BlackRock has filed for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (PBIT), which would use options on IBIT to cushion losses in exchange for capped upside — its third Bitcoin ETF filing. The move lands as IBIT drew $665M on Monday, its strongest session since October 2025, lifting total spot Bitcoin ETF inflows to roughly $527M. Read full story 💳 Mesh and Visa Make Crypto Spendable at 175M Merchants Unveiled at Money20/20 in San Francisco, the partnership lets users pay directly from crypto and stablecoin balances held in wallet apps anywhere Visa is accepted. Mesh provisions a Visa credential behind the scenes and handles conversion, so merchants receive an ordinary fiat transaction. No launch date or first wallet partners have been named yet. More details ⚖️ SEC Closes Comment Window on "Regulation Crypto Assets" The public comment period on the SEC's proposed crypto offering framework (File S7-2026-27) ends October 20. In a last-minute letter, the Hyperliquid Policy Center backed the proposal but requested five changes covering airdrops, token trading, buybacks, safe harbors and state-level protections. The agency now moves to reviewing feedback before finalizing the rules. Read more 🛡️ Tether CEO Pushes Back on Senate Iran Report Paolo Ardoino says Tether froze flagged USDT addresses an average of four weeks before official sanctions designations and claims its freezes cut Iran-linked stablecoin volumes by 94%. He was responding to a Senate subcommittee staff report finding that 84% of 846 Iran-linked sanctioned wallets transacted almost exclusively in USDT. The 94% figure has not been independently verified. See details 🌍 Revolut Secures Gibraltar Crypto License for Global Expansion Gibraltar's Financial Services Commission granted a DLT Provider license to Revolut Global Digital Assets Limited, a new subsidiary built to take the fintech's crypto services beyond the UK and EEA. Revolut reports over 80M customers, including about 16M crypto users, but has not yet named target markets or launch timelines. Full story 🔐 Bitget Eyes Thai Exchange Take
